saw_lines: Nail polish is picked by shade, then judged on wear, so buyers want proof it lasts before they trust a new brand.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides whether the wear claim is worth a click.
Your 30 ads show no proof number, so buyers have only the claim to go on. Collect a review count or orders shipped and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer weighing a new polish has only the claim to go on. Collect one number, such as review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
5 of your 17 copy ads open on “la première gamme de vernis”, so the same buyers see one story again and keep scrolling. Test new openers against it: how Green Flash works, and a customer result.
0 of your 17 copy ads carry an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order discount or a bundle in the first line of each new ad, above the See more cut.

30 of your ads have run 60 days or more, the oldest since February 2026, so the account already has proven winners. Build new variations of the oldest one, same claim and layout, with a new first line.
